description: This file defines the API for a Monochrome Character Framebuffer in Zephyr OS, including data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for framebuffer operations such as drawing text, points, lines, rectangles, and managing fonts.

methods.name: cfb_print
methods.description: Prints a string into the framebuffer at specified coordinates.

methods.name: cfb_draw_text
methods.description: Draws a string into the framebuffer with non tile-aligned coordinates.

methods.name: cfb_draw_point
methods.description: Draws a point at a specified position.

methods.name: cfb_draw_line
methods.description: Draws a line between start and end positions.

methods.name: cfb_draw_rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle defined by start and end positions.

methods.name: cfb_framebuffer_clear
methods.description: Clears the framebuffer and optionally the display.

methods.name: cfb_framebuffer_invert
methods.description: Inverts all pixels in the framebuffer.

methods.name: cfb_invert_area
methods.description: Inverts pixels in a specified area.

methods.name: cfb_framebuffer_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the framebuffer and writes to display RAM.

methods.name: cfb_framebuffer_set_font
methods.description: Sets the current font by index.

methods.name: cfb_get_font_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a font.

methods.name: cfb_get_numof_fonts
methods.description: Returns the number of available fonts.
